name: San Francisco Golf Club
county: City and County of San Francisco
centre_source: estimate between OpenGolfAPI/GolfN (37.7122, -122.4775) and the Broderick-Terry duel landmark beside the 7th tee (37.7082, -122.4842, Wikipedia); address 1310 Junipero Serra Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94132
architects: A. W. Tillinghast (credited; designed c. 1915, opened 1918; remodels c. 1920-24 and 1936-37)
William Lock (possibly the original planner, per GCA research)
Tom Doak with Jim Urbina (greens 2001; original 13-15 restored 2006)
renovations: 1923-24: Tillinghast; 61 bunkers added, new 7th/8th/11th greens, trees planted (GCA, Links, Golf Digest)
1930: William P. Bell and Byrne-Cavendish bunker work (GCA)
1936-37: Tillinghast letters; new 1st, 2nd and 12th, 14th bunkering, 10th green moved (GCA)
c. 1947-50: Harold Sampson redesigned 13-15 for a road widening that never came
2006: Doak and Urbina restored the original 13-15, uncovered the Tarantula bunker, removed hundreds of trees
2013-2024: further tree work (right slope of 8; eucalyptus; 'tree maintenance' 2024)
notable: the 7th 'Duel Hole' (1859 Broderick-Terry duel; California Historical Landmark No. 19)
tees_note: Stymie (third-party); GolfPass/Golf Digest give Championship 6,828 74.1/136, Regular 6,411 71.8/132 (W 78.0/140), Forward 5,981 69.6/126 (W 75.5/135). Legacy women's line is labelled 'Legacy (Red)' on Stymie.
theme: norcal (new Northern California theme shared with Pasatiempo; reuse Cypress Point / Stanford's California theme if one lands first and its trees fit)
wind_note: standing 'open coast' band: about 2 km from the Pacific, gusty sea breezes, the 14th plays into the prevailing wind
water: none found; Lake Merced lies north-west, outside the course
